experiment: exp05 anchor check (amendment 1: all 56 lead line starts of take 1)
annotator: Claude (the agent running exp05). Blind to the Suno, MMS and Whisper positions: panels show none of them, the window centre carries a hidden U(-0.25, 0.25) s jitter, and out/exp05/anchor_key.json was not opened before these labels were committed.
rule: Label = the moment the line's first word becomes audible: the start of its first sound (consonant burst or fricative noise if any, otherwise the start of the energy rise after the previous word's decay). A letter if a detector onset sits there; 'manual:<seconds in window>' if the detector missed it (read off the 0.1 s grid, about +-0.02 s); 'ambiguous' when the boundary cannot be told from the panel (legato joins, vowel after vowel, choir masking, or two equally plausible syllables).

notes.3: 'Linear' starts with /l/: no detector onset at the start of the energy rise after 'high,' decays.
notes.4: Vowel-initial 'And': the detector onset C (0.81) sits ~80 ms after the energy starts rising from silence.
notes.17: 'Start' begins with /s/: high-band noise from ~0.45 s precedes the voiced onset A (0.61).
notes.11, 27, 32, 47: 'We will know!' after a held note: the first change of the note and the next strong onset after a dip are equally plausible starts.
notes.12, 28, 48: 'We will understand!' after the backing echo has decayed: onset after the low-energy region.
notes.15, 31, 51: 'The goal': a short syllable, a /g/ closure (deep dip), then the strong onset of 'goal'; 'The' is the short syllable.
notes.16: The window shows the stem decaying into silence with no new vocal onset.

post_hoc_use_of_confidence: Confidence was recorded at labelling time (blind). Any analysis restricted to 'high' is a sensitivity analysis that was not pre-registered.
